title: Shared definitions
description: Defs referenced by every other contract. Times are epoch seconds (number). Costs are USD numbers.

id8.description: First 8 chars of the todo-app note id.

stage.description: Run stage as written by the runner. See DOCS-spec.md for transitions.

status.description: THE single status, computed on the server by board.status.compute. Never recomputed in the page.

needs.description: Why the task is in Needs you; null in every other column. text names exactly what is needed.

category.description: auto: the server heals it itself. phone: waiting for the phone.

command.description: permission only: the one-line command that grants it (works from any directory).

links.description: Absolute http(s) pages the ask names (a bare route is resolved against an own-host URL of the reply); present only when there are any. The page renders each as a link glyph.

effort.description: Server-computed answers or clicks needed (open questions count one each); Least effort sorts by it, ascending, across repos.

action.description: A button the page may show. enabled=false needs a reason; the page renders it disabled with the reason.

confirm.description: Page asks 'sure?' first (ship, cancel, wont, done-manually).

value.description: priority: the card's priority (high, medium, low; a pick sends {priority} and sets it on the notes behind the card, T2583); copy-resume and copy-fix: the text to copy; model: the pressed model id, the one place the card shows its model (kuhy's pin, else the latest turn's model, else the default one; before Start the saved pick, else the default). A pick before Start only saves it; after Start it reruns the stage.

choices.description: model and priority only: the picker's rows (priority: high, medium, low); a click sends {model: id}: before Start it saves the pick, after Start it reruns the card's stage on it.

note.description: the model the roles run unpinned: its button says so inline

option.description: start (Start/Restart) only: a checkbox sent with the click; disabled needs a reason.

question.description: Spec-stage card: Claude's open question and its recommended answer.

lesson.description: Lesson drafted on a gate rejection; written to a skill only after the approve click.

limit.description: Claude plan limit. until=null when none is active. credits: the paced free API credits (the pace, and the route a new turn takes while the limit holds).

weekly_hold.description: The weekly reserve (T2533): at 90 % of seven_day medium and low cards take no plan turn (low_medium), at 95 % no card does and running plan turns were stopped (all). allowance: more than day N of 7 allows (N/7), no card starts a plan turn and chains stop at their next turn until the next day.

weekly_used.description: The seven_day share the hold last saw (1.0 = full), null with no hold.

weekly_allowance.description: The seven_day share the board may have used by now (day N of 7 = N/7), null until a reading of the current window is known.

partial.description: Live-check outcome when criteria are open or deferred to after the ship; else null.

tier_badges.description: Cheap-tier badges (DOCS-tiers.md): cheap = Sonnet manager; free = free models allowed for the latest implement turn; escalated = Opus took over.

task_card.description: One board card; also the head of the task detail.

repo.description: null: the note has no repo, so it is in Yours.

current.description: One line on what it does or waits on, e.g. 'review round 2/5'.

route.description: Route of the run's latest turn: plan (Max subscription), credits (free API credits, badge on the card) or free (OmniRoute's free models through claude-free while Claude is out, T2531: the free-models tier badge); null before a turn.

waits_on.description: A queued card that waits on another run of the same repo (DOCS-repotask.md, per-repo lock): that run's id.

auto_start.description: Set when a passing done_check started this run (a closing run); kept after Close.

auto.description: `tokenopt` on a run the reset watch started (token optimization after a usage reset, DOCS-credits.md); else, on Backlog cards with a done_check while auto close is on, the latest poll's one-line reason.

app_error.description: Optional: how many tickets of the errors loop (`Error-Signature:` lines, DOCS-errors.md) the card holds.

triage.description: Optional: the label triage gave a note that had no repo (DOCS-triage.md); drawn as an icon.

images.description: Optional (T2535): the todo-images the note links, first-seen order; GET /api/image/<folder>/<file> (relay kind image_get) serves each. The title has their markdown stripped (only an image: the first file name).

auto_start.description: Why a run started without a click: its trusted done_check passed at passed_at.

item_id.description: Card id: <note id8>-<0-based index of the note's '## ' section>, or <repo hash8>-0 for a repo task (DOCS-repotask.md). Also the run-dir name.

checks.description: Latest Checks stage record: done_check, tests, linters. passed = every exit is 0. The last results' tails are the evidence close_task gets.

log.description: Combined log path relative to the run dir.

self_check.description: The implementer's own walk through plan.md's acceptance criteria (its final turn). Informational, never proof.

live_check.description: Record of the live_check stage: Claude ran the changed app/CLI/server and reports what it saw per criterion. Tests and code reading do not count. Shown at the gate and passed to close_task with the checks tails.

report_md.description: What was run, what was seen, per criterion.

shots.description: Screenshot paths relative to the run dir (may be empty).
